other_conditions: Minimum residence of 5 years in Delhi before the date of application
Applicant must have an Aadhaar number
Applicant must have a single‑operated Aadhaar‑linked bank account in Delhi only
Applicant must not be receiving any assistance from the discretionary fund of the Lt. Governor or the Chief Minister for the same purpose
Applicant must not be receiving any pension from Central, State, MCD or NDMC for this purpose
Application must be submitted within 60 days before or after the date of marriage
Grant is limited to up to two daughters and is a one‑time grant
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance of ₹30,000 per eligible case.
